# ####

extract_coxme_table = function (mod){
    beta = fixef(mod)
    nvar = length(beta)
    nfrail = nrow(mod$var) - nvar
    se = sqrt(diag(mod$var)[nfrail + 1:nvar])
    z= round(beta/se, 2)
    p= format(as.numeric(pchisq((beta/se)^2, 1,lower.tail = F)), 4)
    table=data.frame(cbind(beta,se,z,p))
    return(table)
 }

extract_coxph_table = function (mod){
    beta = mod$coefficients
    nvar = length(beta)
    nfrail = nrow(mod$var) - nvar
    se = sqrt(diag(mod$var)[nfrail + 1:nvar])
    z= round(beta/se, 2)
    p= format(as.numeric(pchisq((beta/se)^2, 1,lower.tail = F)), 4)
    table=data.frame(cbind(beta,se,z,p))
    return(table)
 }


#Function to include factor that are NOT in a list

#Function to calculate standard error 
se = function(x) sqrt(var(x,na.rm=T)/length(x))
# 


ggplotprep2 = function(x, times){
  #spreading the surfit dataframe into dataframe per day. 
  d = data.frame(condition=rep(names(x$strata), x$strata), time=x$time, survival=x$surv, upper=x$upper, lower=x$lower)
  # function to add time point 0 
  fillup0 = function(s) rbind(c(condition=s, time=0, survival=1, upper=1, lower=1), d[d$condition==s, ], deparse.level = 0)
  
  # function to determine the missing time points
  indexes = function(x, time) {
    if(x%in%time) return(x)
    return(time[which.min(abs(time[time<x]-x))])
  }
  #Function to complete the missing time points
  fillup = function(s) {
    d.temp = d[d$condition==s, ]
    time = as.numeric(d.temp$time)
    id = sapply(times, indexes, time=time)
    d.temp = d.temp[match(id, time), ]
    d.temp$time = times
    return(d.temp)
  }
  
  if(times[1]==0) d = do.call("rbind", sapply(names(x$strata), fillup0, simplify=F))
  d = do.call("rbind", sapply(names(x$strata), fillup, simplify=F))
  d = data.frame(Condition=d$condition, Time=as.numeric(d$time), Survival=as.numeric(d$survival), Upper=as.numeric(d$upper), Lower=as.numeric(d$lower))
  return(d)
}

```{r Data survival CS sexes}
d_surv_CS = read.table("Data/Surv_CS_Prett0.1.csv", header = T, dec = ".", sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),   # males as reference: HR = female / male
         Experiment = factor(paste0("Exp_", Experiment)),
         Time_to_death = Time_post_injection,                # days post-injection
         # HR over the acute phase: flies dying after day 3 are censored at day 3
         Time_3d   = pmin(Time_to_death, 3),
         Censor_3d = ifelse(Time_to_death <= 3, Censor, 0))

Sample_size_Surv_CS = d_surv_CS %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  summarise(Sample_size = n())
```

```{r Survival CS sexes plot, fig.align="center", fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
survdata = survfit(Surv(Time_to_death, Censor) ~ Sex, data = d_surv_CS)

toplot = ggplotprep2(survdata, times = seq(0, 10, by = 1)) %>%
  mutate(Sex = str_remove(Condition, "Sex="),
         Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")))

(Plot_surv_CS =
  ggplot(toplot, aes(x = Time, y = Survival)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 3, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = grey(0.92)) +  # window used for the HR
  geom_line(aes(colour = Sex), linewidth = linesize) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Sex), size = pointsize) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Male = color_male, Female = color_female)) +
  scale_x_continuous("Days post-injection", breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Proportion of survivors",
                     limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  annotate("text", label = "P. rettgeri", x = 0, y = 0.05, size = 3, hjust = 0, fontface = "italic") +
  basic_theme_Surv +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank()))
```

```{r Analysis survival CS sexes, fig.align="center", fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
# Cox model on the first 3 days, experiment as stratum
model_Surv   = coxph(Surv(Time_3d, Censor_3d) ~ Sex + strata(Experiment), data = d_surv_CS)
model_Surv_0 = coxph(Surv(Time_3d, Censor_3d) ~ 1   + strata(Experiment), data = d_surv_CS)

# Likelihood ratio test of Sex
anova(model_Surv_0, model_Surv)

# Proportional hazards over the 3 days
cox.zph(model_Surv)

# Table of HR, female relative to male
Confint_Surv = as.data.frame(confint(model_Surv, level = 0.95)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Term")

tab_res_surv = extract_coxph_table(model_Surv) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Term")

tab_HR_surv_CS = left_join(tab_res_surv, Confint_Surv, by = "Term") %>%
  dplyr::rename(beta_lower = `2.5 %`, beta_upper = `97.5 %`) %>%
  mutate(across(c(beta, se, z, p), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))),
         Sex = "Female",
         HazardRatio = exp(beta),
         HR_lower = exp(beta_lower),
         HR_upper = exp(beta_upper)) %>%
  add_row(Term = "reference", Sex = "Male", beta = 0, se = 0,
          beta_lower = 0, beta_upper = 0, HazardRatio = 1, HR_lower = 1, HR_upper = 1) %>%
  mutate(Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")))

tab_HR_surv_CS %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3)))

##### Plot ####
(Plot_HR_CS =
  tab_HR_surv_CS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sex, y = beta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = beta_lower, ymax = beta_upper),
                col = "black", linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(col = Sex), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Male = color_male, Female = color_female)) +
  scale_y_continuous("log(HR) (\u00B1 95 % CI)\nrelative to males, days 0-3") +
  scale_x_discrete(NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.25, 1.3)) +
  geom_text(data = Sample_size_Surv_CS,
            aes(x = Sex, y = -0.15, label = paste0("(", Sample_size, ")")),
            size = 2.5, vjust = 1) +
  basic_theme_HR +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))

Plot_surv_CS + Plot_HR_CS + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
```
